It acquires mainly relatively aged, high-quality properties with high asset efficiency, and maintains a high occupancy rate through renovations that utilize know-how gained from the property management business. As of March 31, 2026, the company's own properties totaled 7,148 units in 164 buildings, with an occupancy rate of 99.1%. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, net sales to external customers were ¥6,555 million, of which rental income and monthly-rental sales, etc. were ¥6,251 million and other sales were ¥304 million.
